limitations: Six men games and two women games per applicable model are small descriptive samples, with every observed winner at home.
No whole-season accuracy or promotion conclusion follows from these cohorts; no selection-adjusted or confirmatory interval is claimed.
Original pregame records retain actual=null; later official results live in a separate observation layer.
Official outcomes were reconfirmed through indexed primary-source search; raw HTTP body hashes and exact earlier result-availability times are not fabricated.
No timestamp-matched DraftKings, Kalshi or Polymarket quote was acquired for these new outcome groups; no market outperformance claim is made.
Each actual model/target remains separate; selected ensemble components do not become a retrospective blended original forecast.
summary.official_source_evidence_method: Primary university athletics sources reconfirmed by indexed search; direct HTTP bodies were unavailable. Exact retrieval provenance remains in the pinned outcome review.
